summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. The change adds no new input, trust boundary, dependency, secret, randomness or file I/O. fillTemplate moved unchanged: it uses a replacer function, so '$&'/'$1' patterns in values are not interpreted; it looks up keys with Object.hasOwn, so prototype keys like {constructor} or {__proto__} throw rather than resolving; it fails closed on unknown placeholders; and the regex /\{([^{}]+)\}/g is linear with no catastrophic backtracking. basisText now passes String(observedHands), an internal hand counter (ranges.ts:646, obs.hands), through fillTemplate. Its only template is the constant OBSERVED_BASIS, and the substituted value is not re-scanned, so a value cannot inject further placeholders. scaledWidthPct's early return behaves the same as the old Math.min form for every n, including NaN and Infinity (NaN still propagates and Infinity still yields o), so no new failure mode appears. Rendered text goes to the hint UI; this change does not alter how it is inserted into the DOM.
